title: historicalRecord
responsibility: Normalize historical identities and outcomes, preserving individual reverify attempts with their original model and elapsed time.

inputs.name: historicalIdentity.data
inputs.description: Parsed historical result metadata; prefers explicit task/unit identity and normalizes its status without executing result content.

inputs.name: historicalIdentity.path
inputs.description: Filesystem address to read; JSON and filesystem failures propagate. Historical identity uses only its containing folder as a fallback.

inputs.name: historicalOutcome.status
inputs.description: Defaults to undefined, which normalizes to fail because no passing or cancelled status was recorded.

inputs.name: historicalAttempts.record
inputs.description: Aggregate result record providing stable source identity, phase and the inferred final timestamp. Non-reverify records remain single jobs.

inputs.name: historicalAttempts.data
inputs.description: Parsed result with optional serial tried entries. Finite nonnegative attempt durations preserve each model and outcome; incomplete attempt timing retains the aggregate.

outputs.name: historicalIdentity
outputs.description: Task and unit identity using explicit result fields before the result directory name.

outputs.name: historicalOutcome
outputs.description: Normalized pass, fail or cancelled lifecycle outcome.
